user.title: Tuya cloud credentials
user.description: Setup uses the Tuya cloud once to fetch your fireplace's local key; control then runs locally over your network. Enter your Tuya IoT project details. The Device ID is any device from your account (used to look up the project) — you'll pick the fireplace next. See the README for how to create the IoT project.

select_device.title: Select your fireplace
select_device.description: Found {discovered} Tuya device(s) on your network. Choose the fireplace — its local key is fetched from the cloud and its IP is auto-detected from the LAN where possible. If the IP field is blank, enter it manually (from your router's device list); reserve it so it doesn't change.

reconfigure.title: Update fireplace connection
reconfigure.description: Update the fireplace's IP address or protocol version — useful if its IP changed. The IP is re-detected from the LAN where possible. Your cloud credentials and local key are kept.

error.cloud_error: Could not reach the Tuya cloud. Check the region, Access ID and Access Secret, and that your IoT project has the Smart Home data source and a linked app account.
error.no_devices: No devices were found on this Tuya account. Make sure your app account is linked to the IoT project.
error.no_local_key: The Tuya cloud did not return a local key for this device. Try again in a few minutes, or check the IoT project linkage.
error.no_ip: The fireplace's IP address couldn't be auto-detected. Enter it manually — find it in your router's device list.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the fireplace locally. Check the IP address and protocol version, ensure Home Assistant is on the same network, and fully close the Tuya app while testing.

error.temp_range: The minimum temperature must be lower than the maximum temperature.

init.title: Scandia fireplace data points
init.description: Map the Tuya data point (DP) IDs to fireplace functions. Leave an optional field blank to disable that feature. Download the integration's diagnostics to see the raw DP IDs your device reports.
